datasets.license: US government public-data terms; verify package metadata

datasets.name: FERC Form 714 balancing-authority data

datasets.name: FERC Form 715 transmission planning cases
datasets.use: Recorded only to document the unavailable real-network source

datasets.name: FEMA National Risk Index county table v1.20

datasets.name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
datasets.use: Flood zones and effective flood-map features

datasets.name: USGS earthquake feeds and hazard services

datasets.name: US Drought Monitor GIS
datasets.use: Weekly drought-severity polygons
datasets.caveat: Use authoritative vector products rather than display rasters for analysis

datasets.name: Wildfire Risk to Communities

datasets.name: USFS Wildfire Hazard Potential
datasets.use: National 270 m wildfire-hazard raster
datasets.caveat: Long-term hazard indicator, not a current fire perimeter

datasets.name: EPA RE-Powering Mapper
datasets.use: Brownfields, landfills, mines, and contaminated-land candidate sites
datasets.caveat: Screening data is not site verification and includes older criteria vintages

datasets.name: USGS Protected Areas Database of the US
datasets.use: Protected-land exclusion and stewardship status
datasets.caveat: Version-to-version area totals are not directly comparable

datasets.name: USFWS National Wetlands Inventory
datasets.use: Wetland and deepwater exclusion layers
datasets.caveat: Not a regulatory jurisdiction determination

datasets.name: USGS 3D Elevation Program
datasets.use: Elevation, slope, terrain, and drainage proxies
datasets.caveat: Select a consistent resolution and vertical datum

datasets.name: Annual National Land Cover Database
datasets.use: Annual 30 m land cover, impervious surface, and tree canopy
datasets.caveat: Raster archive is large; clip to candidate buffers

datasets.name: Census TIGER/Line counties, 2024
datasets.use: County boundaries and FIPS joins
datasets.caveat: Use matching geographic vintages when joining census attributes

datasets.name: American Community Survey API
datasets.use: Population, demographics, income, housing, and vulnerability features
datasets.caveat: Margins of error matter, especially for small geographies

datasets.name: CMS Hospital General Information
datasets.use: Current hospital names, addresses, ownership, and classifications
datasets.caveat: Geocode addresses or reconcile against another spatial source

datasets.name: EPA Public Water System Service Areas
datasets.use: Community and non-community drinking-water service boundaries
datasets.caveat: Many boundaries are modeled rather than utility-certified

datasets.name: EPA ECHO facility downloads
datasets.use: Geocoded regulated facilities including water-system records
datasets.caveat: Regulatory facility presence is only a proxy for critical electric load

datasets.name: NTAD military-base boundaries, Texas
datasets.license: CC0 / US government public data per service metadata
datasets.use: Publicly releasable military-installation boundaries
datasets.caveat: Not a comprehensive inventory of sensitive or restricted facilities

datasets.name: NTAD military-base boundaries, Minnesota
datasets.license: CC0 / US government public data per service metadata
datasets.use: Publicly releasable military-installation boundaries for Minnesota
datasets.caveat: Not a comprehensive inventory of sensitive or restricted facilities; python -m pipelines.build_state_context --state MN --dod <path> loads it county-assigned only (load_dod never calls join_critical_loads_to_bus for this path), so bus_id stays NULL while the synthetic topology is Texas-only

datasets.name: MnGeo/MPUC electric utility service areas
datasets.license: No reusable license statement is returned by the service metadata; preserve publisher metadata and obtain terms before redistribution
datasets.use: Retail electric service territories, the Minnesota counterpart to the New York service-territory layer
datasets.caveat: Official statewide EUSA map per the MPUC April 9, 2014 Order in Docket 12-957; retail boundaries only, with no line, substation, terminal, or connectivity claim; native CRS is EPSG:26915. See data/sources/minnesota-source-authority-ledger-v1.json

datasets.name: MISO public market and operations reports
datasets.license: Public MISO market data; observe MISO terms of use
datasets.use: Minnesota-region load, fuel mix, and LMP context, the MISO counterpart to the ERCOT feeds
datasets.caveat: EIA-930 already supplies MISO hourly balancing-authority totals through pipelines.eia930 and is the loaded source; these reports add market resolution and are not wired to a loader

datasets.name: Minnesota PUC electric service-quality and reliability filings
datasets.use: Annual utility SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reporting, the Minnesota counterpart to the Texas PUCT service-quality reports
datasets.caveat: Utility- and year-specific eDockets documents; reporting definitions differ from EAGLE-I coverage, so validate overlap before comparing outage rates

datasets.name: Minnesota Geospatial Commons
datasets.license: Per-dataset; most are open state government data
datasets.use: State hydrography, land-cover, and critical-facility layers that the national FEMA/USGS layers resolve only coarsely
datasets.caveat: Per-dataset licensing and vintages; record the resource identifier and vintage for every layer actually used

datasets.name: RTS-GMLC reliability test system
datasets.use: Small benchmark with hourly and five-minute operations data
datasets.caveat: Synthetic benchmark, not Texas geography

datasets.name: PyPSA-USA
datasets.license: MIT for code; upstream data licenses vary
datasets.use: Reproducible national zonal and synthetic nodal grid construction
datasets.caveat: Modeled network; review every upstream dataset license

datasets.name: Microsoft GridSFM models and data pipeline
datasets.license: Review model, code, and underlying public-data licenses separately
datasets.use: Public OPF-solvable state and regional synthetic models
datasets.caveat: New research release; validate methodology before production use

datasets.name: NREL Annual Technology Baseline
datasets.use: Generation and storage technology cost and performance assumptions
datasets.caveat: Scenario assumptions are not project quotes

datasets.name: NREL Cambium
datasets.use: Modeled hourly grid costs, emissions, and futures through 2050
datasets.caveat: Scenario output, not an operational forecast

datasets.name: EPA eGRID
datasets.use: Plant generation, emissions, heat input, and resource mix
datasets.caveat: Annual accounting data is not real-time dispatch telemetry

datasets.name: LBNL Queued Up interconnection queues
datasets.license: Review LBNL data-use and citation terms
datasets.use: Cleaned project-level interconnection queues across grid operators
datasets.caveat: Queue presence does not imply a project will be built

datasets.name: LBNL generator interconnection costs
datasets.license: Review LBNL data-use and citation terms
datasets.use: Project-level network-upgrade and interconnection cost benchmarks
datasets.caveat: Historical study costs do not replace a new interconnection study

datasets.name: NRC operating-reactor datasets
datasets.use: Reactor status, events, inspections, scrams, and operating history
datasets.caveat: Operating-reactor records do not establish suitability for a new site

datasets.name: DOE-417 electric emergency incidents
datasets.license: US government public data; review incident-data terms
datasets.use: National event-level disturbance labels including timing, geography, demand, and customers affected
datasets.caveat: Threshold-triggered reports are not a complete record of every local outage

datasets.name: EPA Clean Air Markets Program Data
datasets.license: US government public data; API key and rate limits apply
datasets.use: Hourly unit-level generation, operating time, heat input, emissions, and facility attributes
datasets.caveat: Coverage is concentrated in units subject to federal power-sector programs and is not all generation

datasets.name: OpenFEMA disaster declarations
datasets.use: Federally declared event type, dates, programs, and affected geography since 1953
datasets.caveat: County data is unavailable before 1964 and historical fire-management records are partial

datasets.name: OpenFEMA Public Assistance funded projects
datasets.use: Daily-updated project obligations for disaster damage and recovery-cost proxies
datasets.caveat: Obligations are program-finance records, not direct measurements of outage restoration time

datasets.name: HHS emPOWER electricity-dependent population
datasets.use: Monthly state, county, and ZIP counts of Medicare beneficiaries reliant on electricity-dependent equipment
datasets.caveat: Claims-based Medicare population can underestimate total electricity-dependent residents

datasets.name: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index
datasets.use: Census-tract and county vulnerability themes for impact weighting and equity guardrails
datasets.caveat: Percentile scores are release-specific and should not be compared across years as absolute values

datasets.name: USGS national hydrography products
datasets.use: Rivers, streams, waterbodies, watersheds, dams, and network navigation for flood and cooling-water context
datasets.caveat: Legacy NHD is retired; prefer current 3DHP/NHDPlus products and record the release used

datasets.name: LANDFIRE vegetation, fuels, and disturbance
datasets.use: Consistent vegetation, fuel, and disturbance features around lines and substations
datasets.caveat: Raster products require regional clipping and do not encode utility vegetation-maintenance history

datasets.name: FHWA National Bridge Inventory
datasets.use: Bridge location and condition attributes for coarse crew-access and restoration-logistics features
datasets.caveat: Inspection data may lag and must not be used for route-clearance decisions

datasets.name: NYISO public market and grid data
datasets.license: Review NYISO website and data-use terms
datasets.use: Zonal load, forecasts, LBMPs, fuel mix, outages, interface flows, constraints, events, and BTM solar
datasets.caveat: Archive URLs are date-partitioned and public data omits protected operational details

datasets.name: NYISO 2025 Load and Capacity Data Report
datasets.use: New York load, capacity, transmission facilities, and proposed transmission projects
datasets.caveat: Planning snapshot; proposed facilities are not guaranteed to be built

datasets.name: New York electric utility service territories
datasets.use: Utility-to-municipality service-area crosswalk for assigning assets, outages, and reliability reports
datasets.caveat: Public boundaries are planning context and may not resolve every retail-service exception

datasets.name: New York DPS electric reliability reports
datasets.use: Utility SAIFI/CAIDI, major-storm impacts, outage cause codes, worst circuits, and corrective actions
datasets.caveat: Metrics and exclusions must be normalized before cross-utility or cross-state comparison

datasets.name: New York Utility Energy Registry
datasets.use: Privacy-screened monthly electricity and gas use by ZIP code, utility, and customer class
datasets.caveat: Suppressed values are missing for privacy and must not be interpreted as zero consumption

datasets.name: NYSERDA disadvantaged communities
datasets.use: New York-specific 2020 Census tract designations and indicators for equity analysis
datasets.caveat: Use Version 2.0 consistently and do not substitute the older Version 1.0 layer

datasets.name: Texas RRC pipelines, wells, and production data
datasets.license: Texas public data with RRC disclaimers

datasets.name: Texas statewide cursory floodplain dataset

datasets.name: Texas regional flood planning GIS services
datasets.license: Texas public data; review TWDB terms and restricted-field notices

datasets.name: New Braunfels Utilities electric service boundary

datasets.use: Company and feeder SAIDI/SAIFI, outage causes, worst-feeder narratives, and remediation plans

datasets.name: NERC GADS public statistics
datasets.use: Aggregate generating-unit outage-rate calibration
datasets.caveat: Raw unit-level records are not generally public

datasets.name: NERC TADS public statistics
datasets.use: Aggregate transmission outage-rate calibration
datasets.caveat: Raw element-level outage records are not generally public
